definitions.full: H6125. aqah [ עָקָה ] noun feminine pressure (si vera lectio, Aramaic word, עָֽקְתָא ᵑ7 , Syriac ); — only construct רָשָׁע עָקַת מִמְּנֵי Psa 55:4 because of the pressure of the wicked ; > read צַעֲקַת (|| קוֺל ; Ol and others), which means cry for help .
